faq.q: What can I make with AIVideosUGC?
faq.a: You can make short video ads, product and unboxing videos, white-background photos, lifestyle photos, model photos and social ad images. Most start from a photo of your product.
Upload a clear photo of the product you sell, with the whole item in frame. A phone photo on a plain background works well. Only upload photos you own or have permission to use.

faq.q: Can I use a product page link to start a video?
faq.a: Yes. URL to Video accepts a product page link. Choose the size and length, then check the credit price before the job starts.

faq.q: How much does a video or photo cost?
faq.a: Each job shows its credit price before you start. A photo or a 6-second clip is 24 credits, a 10-second clip is 40, 15 seconds is 60 and 30 seconds is 120. Credits for a failed job go back to your balance.

faq.q: Is the person in the video a real creator?
faq.a: No. The people in these clips are generated by AI. Use them as part of your product marketing, not as customer testimonials, and follow any platform rules for AI-generated content.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version of an ad?
faq.a: Yes. Run the same photo with a different scene, presenter or opening, then compare the downloads in your ad account. Each run shows its credit cost first.

faq.q: Can I run these videos as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and can be used commercially on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and marketplaces. Add your own captions, prices and offers, then follow each platform's AI labeling rules.

faq.q: Do I need to hire a model or creator?
faq.a: No. The results start from one product photo, so there is no casting, sample shipping or filming date. Present people in the clips as part of your ad, not as customer reviews.

limitations.h2: Check these details before you publish

items.d: Add your own dimensions and fit notes to the listing.
Photograph ports, seams, backs or contents the upload does not show.
Confirm that any result or demonstration matches a real test.
Add final text in your editor and proofread every number.
Compare the file with the real product before you post.

closing.h2: The AI UGC Video Generator Built for Product Sellers

AIVideosUGC keeps that in one place: videos up to 30 seconds, product photos for every listing, and the cost on screen before each job.

trust.h2: What Sellers Can Count On With AIVideosUGC
trust.lead: The details that matter when you pay per ad.

items.d: Pick 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4 before you start, so each channel gets a file in its own shape.
Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Use a 6-second clip as a hook, or a 30-second clip to show the product in use.
A 6-second video is 24 credits and a 30-second one is 120. You see the cost before every job.
If a job fails, its credits return to your balance on their own. Finished files are charged at the price shown before the job.
Run your videos and photos in paid ads, on product pages and in posts. Downloads carry no watermark.
Your uploads and results stay in your own account. Nothing goes to a public gallery.
